actions.reason: Strong RNA pathway enrichment (interferon/inflammatory) with large effect sizes and significant BAP1 mutation enrichment (q=0.0044) provide coherent biological support. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with RNA and WSI positive, and known-label echo is low. Technical confounding by site CJ is noted but does not invalidate the biological signal.

No significant biological enrichment in any modality, weak cross-modal consistency (only WSI positive, high PAC), and no technical confounding. The set lacks sufficient evidence to support a distinct subtype.

RNA pathway enrichment is significant but WXS and CNV are not, and cross-modal consistency is weak (only RNA positive, low silhouettes, high PAC). The biological signal is not coherent across modalities, and no technical confounding explains the set. Insufficient evidence for a robust subtype.
